_note: The multiplayer map editor's session screen (pages/together.rml, oz_ui_together.cpp; ENGINE_PLAN.md PE). tab: host or join. Host: source (new, mine: one of the editor's maps, game: a game map imported by q3map2), mine (the editor's maps folder: file, name) and mi (the one picked), game (a game map's name), name, password and max (2 to 8). Join: sessions (the online service's listings of mode edit: host, name, owner, map, players, full, password, mine, other: another version, version), answered, count, code (a host's player id typed in), join_password, ask (the locked session waiting on a password). state (off, joining, syncing, live, ended), status and why: the session as it is, and why it ended. online: the online service is connected.
